name: OpenRCT2
subtitle: Open-source theme park sim
promotionalText: Build and manage theme parks with the open-source re-implementation of a classic simulation game. Game files from a purchased copy of the original game are required.
description:
OpenRCT2 for iOS is the iOS port of OpenRCT2, the open-source re-implementation of a classic theme park simulation game.

The app contains no original game assets. Game files from a purchased copy of the original game are required.

GETTING STARTED
1. Obtain the original game: The original game is available on Steam and GOG.
2. Transfer the files to your device: Copy the game folder, a ZIP archive or the GOG installer to the Files app using AirDrop, iCloud Drive or a computer.
3. Import and play: Select the files in the app. Importing takes place entirely on the device, and GOG installers are extracted automatically.

FEATURES
• Content of the first game: Importing the first game is optional and adds its scenarios, graphics and title music.
• Native Metal rendering: Parks are drawn with Metal for smooth scrolling, even in the largest parks.
• Saves in the Files app: Saved games are stored in the Files app, where they can be backed up or moved to another device.
• 25 languages: The interface is available in 25 languages, with pixel fonts for Chinese, Japanese and Korean.
• Runs on Mac: The app also runs on Mac computers with Apple silicon.
• No account or tracking: The app requires no account and contains no advertising, analytics or tracking.

OpenRCT2 is open-source software released under the GNU General Public License v3.
